claims: The Masters is an annual men's major professional golf tournament.
The Masters is held at Augusta National Golf Club.
The Masters is usually held in early April.
The Masters has been held at Augusta National since 1934.
The Green Jacket is awarded to winners of the Masters.
The Masters field includes past champions.
The Masters field includes top PGA Tour performers.
The Masters field includes amateur invitees.
No cell phones are allowed on the course during the Masters.
Jack Nicklaus holds the record for most Masters wins with six wins.
Tiger Woods has five Masters wins.
A master's degree (e.g., MA, MS) is a postgraduate academic qualification.
The 2026 Masters takes place from April 9-12, 2026.
The 2026 Masters is located in Augusta, Georgia, USA.
